entries.headline: The retry loop resends webhooks with the same idempotency key, so a partner that ignores the key will book the payment twice.
Dark mode reads the theme from a cookie that the CDN caches for an hour, so some users will see the old theme after switching.
The Postgres 17 plan drops the old replica before the new one has caught up, so reads go to the primary for a while.
The force push guard is off for this project, so a rebase can overwrite main.
